name: Glimpse Grave OLD

stealth.note: (expert) to notice the words on the tombstone waver

description: A tombstone bears the name of those who look upon it, causing their hearts to seize.
disable: DC 45 Religion (legendary) to bless the tombstone or DC 50 Occultism (trained) to ward off spirits

generalAbilities.name: Stop Heart
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature reads or touches the tombstone

Effect The haunt deals (8d10+44) Void Damage damage (Basic DC 47 Will Saving Throw) to all creatures within 60 feet who can see the tombstone and can read any language. On a critical failure, a creature dies.
